prompt: Make ONLY a framing change to this exact unlettered production reference board. Shrink the entire existing arrangement to 70% of its current width and height and center it on the same white landscape 3:2 canvas. Extend plain white around it. Every leaf, panicle tip, grain, soil and landscape-key edge must sit at least 150 pixels inward from every image edge on a 1536x1024 canvas. Preserve all botanical branching, every subject and the clean bold flat outlined style exactly. No new subjects or lettering.

visualReview.note: Reference directly inspected: open branching rice panicles with individually attached grains, narrow leaves, husked longitudinal grain views; flat outlined style, wide margins, no lettering or later processing states.
visualReview.limits: Individual image inspection recorded from the exact-hash production inspection; independent sequence, reader, scorecards and audio reviewed separately.
